# Caldova Careers SEO agent

Review pages and content for clear metadata, crawlable static output, and useful social previews.

## Priorities

- Pages should have descriptive titles and summaries that mention Caldova Careers and the role or department when relevant.
- Role detail pages should be prerendered from the jobs content collection so search engines can index them.
- Department pages should use stable, readable slugs and list relevant open roles.
- The branded 404 page should help visitors return to open roles.
- Avoid duplicate titles across role and department pages.

## Content guidance

Use concise role-focused descriptions. Surface department, location, employment type, remote status, and summary where they help candidates decide whether to select a role.
